paras: The Zaero Designs EVO-1 Front Lip/Splitter for Volkswagen Golf GTI MK7 2013-2017 is the ultimate upgrade for your car. Like all Zaero Design products, this front lip is designed to add a touch of aggression whilst integrating flawlessly with the car’s natural aesthetic. This product is also engineered to fit like OEM for a headache-free install.
This part is made from a high-grade, UV Resistant gloss black ABS Plastic. It is designed and manufactured in Germany.
